description: MSc Business Management mini-dissertation (BUS7021, Northbridge University) supplied as .docx with a numbered brief and a 100-mark criteria x percentage-band rubric with grade boundaries, so numerical marking is authorised (RUBRIC mode, total 100). The ~2,000-word submission is of reasonable quality but contains five deliberate defects: (1) the methodology has no ethical considerations section and never mentions ethics or consent, although the brief requires one; (2) the reference list has only 8 entries against a required minimum of 10 academic sources; (3) 'Kossek et al. (2014)' is cited in the literature review but has no reference-list entry; (4) 'Bloom, N. ... (2015)' appears in the reference list but is never cited in the text; (5) Objective 2 (effect of flexible working on job satisfaction) is not addressed in the conclusion, which only covers Objectives 1 and 3. Only written-work review should be activated.
